pages.title: Pixel Jam Bus Puzzle: Color Sort
pages.creator: YIGOT
pages.description:
Pixel Jam Bus Puzzle: Color Sort turns a picture made of tiny passengers into a vehicle-sorting puzzle. Choose vehicles for the limited parking area and board each one with passengers matching its color. A full vehicle drives away, opening a space for the next arrival. Clear the pixel picture while keeping parking spaces available.

Vehicle capacity shapes your choices. The game includes one thousand levels, Clear and Shuffle tools for difficult arrangements, and pickup-speed upgrades. Click or tap vehicles and buttons to play.

pages.title: Mojicon Garden Connect
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description: Mojicon Garden Connect is a tile-matching puzzle with a spring garden setting. Select two identical tiles to make a match and continue through the garden-themed puzzles. As you progress, twenty hidden Discoveries become available, introducing different garden friends along the way.

pages.title: World Cup Soccer Caps
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description:
World Cup Soccer Caps turns soccer into a tabletop contest played with a team of caps. Flick the caps to pass the ball, shoot, and send it into the opposing goal.

Click or tap a cap, then drag to set the direction and strength of its movement. Release to take the shot. The placement of each cap and the power you choose shape how you move the ball toward a scoring opportunity.

pages.title: Magic Forest - Merge the Secrets
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Magic Forest - Merge the Secrets combines dropping objects with merging identical items during Masha's forest journey. Each turn brings a new object at the top of the screen. Move it sideways, then release or tap to drop it onto another of the same kind; connecting a matching pair creates a new item.

Space becomes harder to manage as objects gather. When room runs short, Masha can ask for particular items. You can give her what she requests or keep working with the arrangement yourself.

pages.title: Knock and Run. 100 Doors Escape
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description:
Knock and Run. 100 Doors Escape sends a stickman through hotel corridors on a prank-filled escape. Ring, knock, and slam doors while keeping away from residents who might catch you.

Use touch, the cursor, or WASD to move. Your objective is to reach the end of the level, reacting to the residents and dangers along the route.

pages.title: Chroma Trek
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Chroma Trek is a neon platform puzzle about reaching a Finish Crystal through traps and color barriers. Change your color to pass through matching obstacles, then navigate the spikes, pits, and other hazards between you and the goal.

On a keyboard, A and D or the arrow keys move left and right. W or Space jumps. Each stage combines movement with choosing the color needed to get through its barriers.

pages.title: Princess Run 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Princess Run 3D puts a princess on a course where the things she collects affect her charisma. Gather clothes, shoes, and hairstyles while avoiding unwanted outfits, bad weather, and other hazards.

Increasing charisma brings a maid of honor who can help against enemies, mud, and rain. Use mouse clicks or taps to play, choosing what to collect as you move through the 3D running stages.

pages.title: Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description:
Wednesday Addams Beauty Salon is a three-stage makeover game focused on Wednesday's gothic style. Begin with facial care, choose dark-themed makeup, and finish by putting together her outfit.

Use the left mouse button to work through the salon activities. The sequence takes you from skincare and eyeliner to the clothing that completes her look.

pages.title: Monster Dash
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description:
Monster Dash is an action runner starring Barry Steakfries. Sprint through hordes of zombies, vampires, and other monsters, jumping past danger and blasting enemies with the weapons you find. Barry's Machine Gun Jetpack is also part of the monster-fighting action.

The game uses a two-button control system. Running, jumping, and shooting are the central actions as you make your way through the attacking creatures.

pages.title: Trial Xtreme
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description:
Trial Xtreme challenges you to ride a motorcycle from the start to the end of obstacle-filled tracks. Work through thirty levels containing jumps, pipes, stones, and other barriers that interrupt the route.

Collect stars during each race to open the next track. Reaching the finish and gathering enough stars both matter as you advance through the motorcycle courses.

pages.title: Mirrors - Puzzle
pages.creator: KTV
pages.description:
Mirrors - Puzzle asks you to connect points of light by redirecting beams across a board. Place mirrors and rotate them to change the light's path, arranging reflections that link the required dots.

Tap a mirror line to rotate it, then use the Play button to check the connection. The layouts become more complex as you progress, giving you more demanding reflection puzzles to solve.

pages.title: Backflip Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Backflip Master is a movement challenge about reaching the finish line by performing backflips. Flip along the route and get over the obstacles that stand between you and the end. Tap to play, timing your flips as you work toward completing the course.

pages.title: Indygirl and the Golden Skull
pages.creator: Immanitas Ent. GmbH
pages.description: Indygirl and the Golden Skull sends Indygirl into a cave filled with jewels and gold. Help her collect the hidden treasure while running away from a gigantic rolling rock. The chase gives you two connected goals: reach the valuables and keep ahead of the boulder pursuing her.

pages.title: Elemental DressUp Magic
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description:
Elemental DressUp Magic lets you style five heroines inspired by natural elements. Create makeup and clothing looks for girls representing fire, water, earth, and air, then work with an Avatar who combines all four.

Use mouse clicks or touchscreen taps to choose their appearances. Coordinate each heroine's makeup and attire with her element, and save a finished result as a PNG image.

pages.title: Beauty World and Fashion Stylist
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description:
Beauty World and Fashion Stylist combines outfit selection, hair styling, makeup, and room decoration. Open the clothing menu to choose a character, put together an outfit, and change the hairstyle, accessories, and interior around them.

When the makeup button becomes available, you can add cosmetics to the look. Take a picture of the finished styling and save it in the game's gallery.

pages.title: Highway Crazy Bike
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Highway Crazy Bike is a motorcycle-riding game built around weaving through highway traffic. Steer between other cars as you ride at speed, looking for a route through the vehicles ahead. Use the arrow keys to drive, and press Shift to perform a wheelie.

pages.title: Feudal Wars
pages.creator: Feudal Wars
pages.description:
Feudal Wars is a real-time strategy game where you choose one of twelve civilizations and build a base using resources such as gold and wood. Train cavalry, archers, and swordsmen as you develop your settlement through three ages. Victory requires destroying every enemy building.

Select units or buildings with a left click and issue movement, attack, or gathering orders with the right button. Drag a selection box to command a group, or double-click a unit to select similar units on screen. Multiplayer battles put your base development and army management against other players.

pages.title: Impossible Tracks 2D
pages.creator: Abdul Wakil Mondal
pages.description:
Impossible Tracks 2D is a driving challenge with a finish line to reach beyond each level's obstacles. Move forward and backward along the tracks, working past the hazards in your route.

On a keyboard, Right, Up, D, or W moves forward; Left, Down, A, or S moves backward. Touchscreen players use the on-screen gas pedals.

pages.title: Car Escape 3D
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description:
Car Escape 3D is a traffic puzzle about clearing a gridlock without causing a crash. Tap a car to send it in the direction shown by its arrow, and plan the order in which vehicles leave.

Your goal is to free every car. Check the space ahead of a selected vehicle before moving it, using each departure to open routes for the cars still waiting.

pages.title: Strawberella
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Strawberella is a strawberry-princess makeover game with clothing, makeup, and accessory challenges. Put together a look around the pink dress, create the makeup, and choose accessories to complete the character's appearance. Use the mouse to work through the different styling activities.

pages.title: Dash Party
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Dash Party is an arena fighting game where you slide across the ground and cut through opponents. Keep dashing to bring more knife options into your character's hands, and try different characters across the available arenas.

Play alone with WASD, the arrow keys, or mouse controls. Two-player mode gives one player WASD and the other the arrow keys, letting two people share the arena battle.

pages.title: Rally Champion Advanced
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Rally Champion Advanced is a racing game focused on overtaking rivals and reaching first place. Turn left or right to move through the field across a series of rally tracks. Speed lanes provide an advantage over opponents, so look for them while working your way toward the lead.

pages.title: Super Rainbow Friends
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Super Rainbow Friends combines running with survival mini-games. Escape pursuing enemies, avoid the threats around you, and outlast opponents as you work toward surviving each challenge.

Click once to jump or twice to double-jump; touchscreen players use single and double taps. Collect stars during the competition to unlock more characters.

pages.title: Help the Hero
pages.creator: Berezka
pages.description:
Help the Hero is a physics puzzle in which the order of your actions decides whether the hero survives and collects the gold. Pull or reposition flaps, use water and lava to create stone, and release gas against enemies.

Click the flaps to remove them or change their positions, and click a chain to break it.

pages.title: ALIEN WAR
pages.creator: Lover3d
pages.description: ALIEN WAR is a combat game about defending your land from attacking aliens. Fight the invaders and earn coins, then spend those coins on weapon upgrades to strengthen your defense. Your objective is to protect the people under attack.

pages.title: Stack Panda
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun Mobile Entertainment Private Limited
pages.description: Stack Panda is a jumping game where blocks arrive from both sides of the screen. Tap to leap over each incoming block, adding it to the tower growing beneath the panda. Keep clearing the blocks as they approach and try to build the tallest stack you can.

pages.title: One More Bridge
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: One More Bridge challenges you to keep a run going by building spans at the correct moment. Tap the screen to create a bridge, judging both its length and your timing. Waiting too long or making a span that is too short or too long causes a fall. Try to complete a longer sequence of crossings.

pages.title: Ultimate Flying Car
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Ultimate Flying Car combines city driving with flying-car exploration and races. Take a car along the streets or into the sky, and race to unlock more vehicles. Both the exploration and racing modes support one or two players.

Player one drives with WASD, uses Shift for nitro, and Space for the handbrake. Player two uses the arrow keys, M for nitro, and K for the handbrake. T and L provide rear views, while R and U reset the respective cars' positions.

pages.title: Flappy Copter
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Flappy Copter puts a helicopter in a rounded world filled with pipes to pass through. Touch anywhere on the screen to control the copter, guiding it through the openings while avoiding a collision with the pipes.

pages.title: Spring Nail-Art
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Spring Nail-Art combines manicure design with hand decoration. Choose a solid nail color or a spring pattern, then apply mehendi to the hand and finish with rings and bracelets. Use the left mouse button or touch controls to make your selections and put together the design.

pages.title: Wild Animal Doctor Adventure
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Wild Animal Doctor Adventure puts you in a veterinary role caring for injured wild animals. Help treat the wounds of a lion, zebra, bear, crocodile, elephant, and hippo as they recover. Use the mouse to work through the game's animal-care activities.

pages.title: HideNSeek3D
pages.creator: YSO Corp
pages.description:
HideNSeek3D makes you the searcher in a building full of hidden people. Explore the rooms, check behind doors, and look inside closets until you have found everyone.

Walk with WASD or the arrow keys and turn your view with the mouse. Click when you locate one of the hiding people.

pages.title: Find the Teddy Bear
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description:
Find the Teddy Bear is an escape-style search for a little girl's missing toy. Explore the surroundings and look for anything that can help you recover her bear and bring it back.

Use the mouse or touchscreen to interact with the scene as you investigate where the teddy has gone.

pages.title: Chicken Egg Challenge
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description:
Chicken Egg Challenge is a button-pressing race to fill a basket with ten eggs before the other players do. Press quickly to collect eggs and be the first to complete the basket.

The game supports one, two, or three players. Solo play uses J; two players use W and Up, while three-player games use W, J, and Up.

pages.title: Santa Claus Coloring Book
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Santa Claus Coloring Book gives you eighteen Santa pictures to paint using a palette of fifteen colors. Choose a drawing, select colors, and apply them to build its finished appearance.

Use the mouse on a computer or touch controls to color. You can also save a completed image after putting together its color scheme.

pages.title: Merge Fish
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Merge Fish is a puzzle about bringing groups of three or more fish together to earn points. Tap the fish waiting at the sides to send them onto the board, arranging the arrivals so they can merge into fish of another color. Your placements determine which groups can combine next.

pages.title: Hoop Stars
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Hoop Stars puts you in control of a jumping ring that must pass around a ball to score. Click or tap on either side of the play area to send the hoop upward and steer its jump. Line up the ring so the ball passes through its opening, then keep collecting points as you work toward trophies.

pages.title: Shadow Match Halloween
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Shadow Match Halloween asks you to connect a Halloween picture with its silhouette. Examine the image in the left box, then choose the corresponding shadow from the panel on the right.

A correct selection adds 200 points, while a wrong one deducts 40. Click with the mouse or use a touchpad to select your answer.

pages.title: Crayz Monster Taxi
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Crayz Monster Taxi puts a monster-truck taxi on a road to the finish line. Collect coins as you drive and try to reach the end safely and quickly. Use WASD, the arrow keys, or the touch controls to guide the vehicle along its route.

pages.title: Mr Dracula
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Mr Dracula is a Halloween-themed physics shooting puzzle with zombie targets. Aim and tap to fire, working to defeat the enemies in each scene. Your shots are limited, so plan each one around the enemies still standing and make the remaining ammunition count.

pages.title: Math Word Search
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Math Word Search combines arithmetic questions with searching a grid. Work out the results of the mathematical operations, then locate those answers hidden in the word-search puzzle for each level.

Choose easy or difficult mode. The harder option uses timed play and multiplied points, adding a scoring challenge to the calculations and searching. Use the mouse or touch controls to play.

pages.title: Pixelkenstein Merry Merry Christmas
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Pixelkenstein Merry Merry Christmas follows Santa on a gift-collecting trip for the children. Help him gather as many presents as possible while he makes his Christmas rounds. Use WASD or the arrow-key controls, with touch controls also available for the collection task.

pages.title: Happy Halloween 2020 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Happy Halloween 2020 Puzzle offers six Halloween pictures to rebuild as jigsaws. Pick an image and assemble it from its separate pieces using the mouse.

Each picture has four options: 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Choose a smaller piece count for a shorter assembly or a larger one for a more detailed puzzle.

pages.title: Rio Rex
pages.creator: gametornado
pages.description:
Rio Rex lets you rampage through Rio de Janeiro as a T-Rex. Destroy the surroundings, eat the humans in your path, and use the dinosaur's fire breath to spread destruction through the city.

Move Rex with the arrow keys and use the mouse to aim and eat as you work through the destructive adventure.

pages.title: Fishout
pages.creator: IG
pages.description:
Fishout is an underwater brick-breaking game about freeing fish from cages. Move the paddle to bounce a ball into the cages, breaking them open until the fish are released.

Keep the paddle beneath the returning ball so it does not fall off the screen. Use the keyboard or tap the screen to position the paddle and continue the rescue.

pages.title: Offroad Racing 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Offroad Racing 2D is a driving game with several cars and levels to play. Choose a car and use the arrow keys to control it as you work through the game's off-road driving courses.

pages.title: Candy Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Candy Mahjong is a tile-matching puzzle with the goal of emptying the board. Select identical tiles with two open sides to remove them, working through the available matches until the whole layout is cleared.

Hints and shuffling can help when you get stuck. Use the mouse or touchpad to select the matching pieces and continue toward completing the level.

pages.title: farming simulator Game
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: farming simulator Game puts you behind the controls of heavy farming vehicles for agricultural transport tasks. Drive a tractor to move farming machinery between the city and town, using the keyboard arrow keys to control the vehicle.

pages.title: Water Race 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Water Race 3D is a water-skating game about traveling farther and building a high score. Slide on the screen to steer around the obstacles along the course. Hitting a hazard ends the attempt, so keep clear of the barriers while trying to improve your distance and points.

pages.title: Sport Drag Car Racing Game
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Choose a car and race toward the finish line in Sport Drag Car Racing Game. Work through the available levels, controlling your vehicle along the course.

pages.title: Jump Temple
pages.creator: Eery Lab s.c.
pages.description: Jump Temple is an arcade jumping game set in dark caverns filled with spikes, traps, and enemies. Time your jumps to get through the dangers and deal with the different mechanics and power-ups along the way. The game generates its levels procedurally, providing an ongoing sequence of courses to attempt.

pages.title: Extreme Speed
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Extreme Speed is a car-control challenge about changing the vehicle's rotation while avoiding walls. Touch the screen to turn the car, timing your inputs to keep it clear of the edges as it moves.

pages.title: Tower Loot
pages.creator: TD2TL
pages.description: Tower Loot is a puzzle about using magic to remove platforms and get a treasure chest. Select platforms with the mouse or touch controls and decide which ones to remove to make the treasure accessible.

pages.title: Motorbike Drive
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description:
Motorbike Drive gives you three bikes and four maps built for riding and stunts. Choose a motorcycle and an environment, then use the platforms placed around the map to practice different maneuvers.

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, use Space for the handbrake, and press Shift to boost. C changes the camera view, letting you choose another perspective while riding around the stunt areas.

pages.title: Moto Real Bike Racing
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description:
Moto Real Bike Racing combines motorcycle riding with missions, different maps, and bike modification options. Pick from the available bikes and take on the game's driving challenges.

Use Up or W to accelerate, Down or S to brake, and the left and right controls to steer. Left Shift activates nitro, while Space applies the handbrake, giving you separate controls for speed changes and braking.

pages.title: Soccer Ping.io
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Soccer Ping.io is a goal-scoring game played with the mouse. Send the balls toward the opposing goal, trying to win the match with your shots.

pages.title: Cowboy Hidden Stars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description:
Cowboy Hidden Stars challenges you to find ten concealed stars in each picture before time runs out. There are six levels, each requiring you to locate every hidden star.

Repeated clicks in the wrong place remove an additional five seconds from the timer. Search the image carefully and click or tap a star when you spot it, balancing a quick search with accurate selections.

pages.title: Happy Fill Glass
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Happy Fill Glass is a drawing puzzle about refilling an empty glass. Draw lines to guide the water toward the container, choosing their shapes and positions to create a route for the flow.

pages.title: Fast Fruit
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Fast Fruit is a fruit-cutting game with normal and limited-time modes. Use the mouse or touchscreen to slice as much fruit as you can, keeping clear of bombs and trying not to miss the falling fruit.

pages.title: YORG.io 3
pages.creator: Tobias Springer IT Solutions
pages.description:
YORG.io 3 combines base construction, tower defense, and supply-chain planning. Build up your base and organize its defenses to survive zombie attacks, managing the supply side of the operation alongside the fighting.

The game also includes multiplayer and ranked matches, adding different ways to take on its mix of building and defense.

pages.title: Sweet Candy Match 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Sweet Candy Match 3 is a timed matching puzzle with seventeen levels. Arrange pieces of the same type into horizontal or vertical lines of at least three to remove them and clear the dirty cells. Finish clearing those cells before the level's time runs out. Use the mouse to play.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Halloween Party
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description:
Baby Hazel Halloween Party lets you help Hazel and her costumed friends enjoy a Halloween celebration. Join activities such as trick-or-treating and the magical bowl, and help with the needs that arise during the party.

Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and the other children as they play games and try playful scares on one another.

pages.title: Portal Box
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description:
Portal Box is a 3D puzzle-platform game about rolling a green box onto a green target tile. Once sent in a direction, the box keeps moving until it reaches a block or the platform's edge. Use the arrow keys and plan each move around that continuing motion.

Each level has its own passcode, which lets you return directly to that stage later.

pages.title: FG Gold Mine
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: FG Gold Mine is an arcade mining game where each level sets a target to reach. Use the mouse to mine gold and work toward the current level's requirement before moving through the game's different challenges.

pages.title: Hiking in Style
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Elsa and Ladybug dress for a new trail in Hiking in Style. The two friends want hiking looks that combine comfort with fashion, and you choose their outfits for the outing. Use the mouse or touch controls to make the clothing selections.

pages.title: Redemption Slot Machine
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Redemption Slot Machine is a Wild West-themed slot simulation played without a real-money stake. Set a bet and the active paylines, then spin the reels and check the paytable for the possible winning combinations.

After a win, you can choose to risk the game coins in a double-chance round for a larger simulated reward. The decisions center on the spin settings and whether to try increasing a win.

pages.title: 3d Airplane Race Simulator
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description:
3d Airplane Race Simulator challenges you to fly through rings to complete twenty levels. Progress unlocks additional airplanes, giving you different aircraft to take through the flying courses.

Use the mouse or arrow keys to turn, A and D for the rudder, and the number keys 1, 2, and 3 to perform tricks. Line up the plane with the rings as you work through each level.

pages.title: Zombie Mission
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Zombie Mission is a cooperative action game about recovering important records protected by zombies. Work with a friend to collect the disks, using guns to help complete missions that become harder as you advance.

Player one moves with WASD, attacks with F, and switches guns with Q. Player two uses the arrow keys to move, L to attack, and K for a grenade.

pages.title: Craft Sharp Shooter
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Craft Sharp Shooter is a shooting game with selectable weapons and ammunition management. Equip your weapons and fight other characters while watching your current and reserve ammo. Reload when needed and use the game's kill and score displays to follow the battle.

pages.title: Wormo.io
pages.creator: Jetti Games AB
pages.description: Wormo.io is a worm game where eating gems makes your worm longer. Shoot at other worms to push them away while gathering more gems. Growth and the ability to shove rivals with shots are the central parts of the action.

pages.title: 10x10
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: 10x10 is a block-placement puzzle played on a ten-by-ten board. Place the supplied blocks with the left mouse button and complete lines to make them disappear. Clearing a line opens space for further pieces, so consider how each shape fits into the gaps around it.

pages.title: Wizards vs Swamp Creatures
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Wizards vs Swamp Creatures puts a wizard against jelly-like creatures in the swamps around a tower. Launch fireballs at the creatures and hunt them down, taking on the swamp's inhabitants as the game's central challenge.

pages.title: BigHero.io
pages.creator: 4j.com
pages.description:
BigHero.io is a multiplayer combat game where characters carry their own weapons. Avoid attacks from rivals, who can turn you into a soul stone if they defeat you.

Collect soul stones to extend your weapon's length, and keep competing to climb the leaderboard. Your growing reach develops alongside the challenge of staying clear of other characters' attacks.

pages.title: Happy Hop Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Happy Hop Online challenges you to jump between platforms while collecting stars. Watch for traps and platforms that fall away, choosing your landings to keep the character moving.

You can also purchase costumes to change the character's appearance. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to play through the platform-hopping challenge.

pages.title: Luxury Bath Design
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Luxury Bath Design is an interior-design game about giving a damaged bathroom a makeover. Decorate the room for clients who want a luxurious result, using the mouse to work on its appearance and put together your design.

pages.title: Princess Foot Doctor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
Princess Foot Doctor puts you in charge of caring for a princess with a painful injured foot. Work through the game's foot-care activities to help her recover from the injury and infection.

After treatment, finish her look with accessories and matching shoes. Use the mouse to interact with the game's objects.

pages.title: ELEVATOR SPACE
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description:
ELEVATOR SPACE is a tower-building timing game. Tap to stop a moving marker and create the next floor, trying to line it up with the center of the previous one. Off-center placements make the next floor smaller.

Keep adding floors to build a taller elevator tower and reach space targets. Careful timing helps preserve the size of the floors as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Halloween Remembers
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Halloween Remembers is a sequence-memory game with jack-o'-lanterns. Watch the pumpkin pattern, remember its order, and reproduce the same sequence.

pages.title: Snail Bob 6
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Snail Bob 6 takes Bob through a winter puzzle adventure with a Christmas theme. Help him stay alive by interacting with the environment and solving the obstacles in his route. The adventure includes three-star level goals and minigames to unlock.

Use the mouse to click objects, press 1 to change Bob's direction, and press 2 to make him move faster.

pages.title: Fashion Contest Preps
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Fashion Contest Preps is a dress-up game about getting three princesses ready for a fashion gala. Prepare their contest outfits as they compete for first place, putting together the looks they will wear for the event.

pages.title: Scientist vs Aliens
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description:
Scientist vs Aliens combines an alien defense battle with a match-three puzzle. Swap neighboring tiles to make lines of at least three matching pieces. Clearing those matches makes the scientist fire at the approaching alien and reduces its health.

Keep making matches before the alien reaches the scientist. Contact ends the attempt, so choosing the next swap quickly matters as well as finding a valid combination.

pages.title: Spooky Halloween Ice Cream
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Spooky Halloween Ice Cream asks you to help princesses decorate a dessert for Halloween. Add Halloween-themed treats to the ice cream and put together its festive appearance.

pages.title: Stickman Archer 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Stickman Archer 2 challenges you to defeat enemies with your bow before they kill your character. Drag and release with the mouse or touch controls to attack, aiming your arrows at the opponents.

Headshots provide rewards for buying character upgrades. Keep landing shots while trying to stay alive through the encounters.

pages.title: Sea Bubble Pirates
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Sea Bubble Pirates is a bubble-shooting puzzle played aboard a pirate ship. Aim the cannon and fire at bubbles of the same color to make them pop. Earn golden coins during the bubble-popping adventure, using mouse or keyboard controls to play.

pages.title: Solitaire 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Solitaire 2 is a card-sorting puzzle where you arrange cards in order from ace to king. Use the mouse or touch input to work with the cards, building toward the required sequence.

pages.title: Princess Spring Wardrobe
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Spring Wardrobe is a dress-up game about choosing an outfit for a spring day. Look through the princess's seasonal wardrobe and select from its fashion items to put together her look.

pages.title: Prom Queen Challenge
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Prom Queen Challenge puts Elsa and Barbie in a contest for the queen's title. Help style their looks from the available dresses and accessories, choosing outfits for the two rivals as they prepare for the final fashion contest.
